limitations: Configuration and operator attestation are not live provider, legal, clinical or carrier certification.
Synthetic dataset fixtures are non-speech tones and fictional records; reported numeric examples are not clinic outcomes.
Actual data eligibility, consent, licenses and privacy-review truth remain outside metadata-only validation.
External refunds/disputes are recorded with authorized staff evidence, not executed by an invented gateway API.
Refer to separate PostgreSQL, browser, media, deployment and restore evidence before interpreting project-wide readiness.
